Convert to rad: lat1=0.864 rad, lon1=2.225 rad; lat2=0.660 rad, lon2=-2.137 rad. dlat= -0.204 rad; dlon= -4.362 rad. a=sin^2(dlat/2)+cos(lat1)*cos(lat2)*sin^2(dlon/2). sin(dlat/2)=sin(-0.102)= -0.1019; squared=0.0104. sin(dlon/2)=sin(-2.181)= -0.818; squared=0.669. cos(lat1)=0.648; cos(lat2)=0.789.
